# couchbase-capella_app_service_maintenance_window (Resource)

Manages the preferred weekly maintenance window for an operational App Service.

An App Service has at most one maintenance window. If a window is already set (for example through the Capella UI), creating this resource fails instead of overwriting it; import the existing window with `terraform import couchbase-capella_app_service_maintenance_window.<name> organization_id=<organization_id>,project_id=<project_id>,cluster_id=<cluster_id>,app_service_id=<app_service_id>` and manage it from Terraform.

The maintenance window endpoints are only available to organizations enabled for self-service upgrades.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "couchbase-capella_app_service_maintenance_window" "new_maintenance_window" {
  organization_id  = "aaaaaa-bbbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
  project_id       = "aaaaaa-bbbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
  cluster_id       = "aaaaaa-bbbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
  app_service_id   = "aaaaaa-bbbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
  preferred_day    = "sunday"
  preferred_hour   = 2
  preferred_minute = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_service_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the appService.
- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `preferred_day` (String) The day of the week (UTC) the maintenance window starts on, in lowercase: `monday`, `tuesday`, `wednesday`, `thursday`, `friday`, `saturday` or `sunday`.
- `preferred_hour` (Number) The hour of the day (UTC) the maintenance window starts at, from 0 to 23.
- `preferred_minute` (Number) The minute of the hour (UTC) the maintenance window starts at, from 0 to 59.
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import couchbase-capella_app_service_maintenance_window.new_maintenance_window organization_id=<organization_id>,project_id=<project_id>,cluster_id=<cluster_id>,app_service_id=<app_service_id>
```
